title: almagestd config
description: Main HuJSON/JSON configuration file for ./bin/almagestd. The daemon owns Config, Logs, and System; the engine owns nodes; pasta workspace owns the capitalized keys inside each node object. Node implementations own non-capitalized keys inside node objects and may add, remove, or reinterpret them dynamically.

IdleMilliseconds.description: Autosave debounce time in milliseconds. Non-positive values are accepted by the daemon but are treated as the default 500 ms.

logCacheConfig.description: Daemon-owned per-level in-memory log cache sizes. Missing values use daemon defaults; negative values are clamped to 0.

systemConfig.description: Daemon/platform-owned system integration configuration. Type selects the integration; platform-specific native settings may be owned below this object.

Type.description: debug uses the daemon debug integration. native delegates to the current platform integration.

debugSystemConfig.description: Options for the daemon debug sysnet integration. These options are read only when System.Type is debug.

DisableTun.description: Report regular TUN creation as unsupported and reject BuildTun.

DisableDefaultTun.description: Report default TUN creation as unsupported and reject BuildDefaultTun.

DisableDynTun.description: Report dynamic regular TUN updates as unsupported.

DisableDynDefaultTun.description: Report dynamic default TUN updates as unsupported.

DisableTunNames.description: Report regular TUN naming as unsupported.

DisableDefaultTunNames.description: Report default TUN naming as unsupported.

DisableStrictMode.description: Report strict default TUN routing as unsupported.

debugDefaultTunConfig.description: Debug BuildDefaultTun behavior. The default builder returns a gonnect-netstack VTun and exposes it through a localhost SOCKS proxy.

Builder.description: vtun-socks returns a netstack VTun and starts a local SOCKS proxy backed by it. pipe uses sysnet/debug's in-memory pipe-backed default TUN.

SocksHost.description: Host address for the debug DefaultTun SOCKS listener when Builder is vtun-socks.

SocksPort.description: TCP port for the debug DefaultTun SOCKS listener. Use 0 to let the OS choose an available port.

Name.description: Name passed to the netstack VTun builder.

NoLoopbackAddr.description: Do not add loopback addresses to the debug VTun.

EndpointCh.description: Endpoint channel size passed to the netstack VTun builder.

EventCh.description: Event channel size passed to the netstack VTun builder.

linuxSystemConfig.description: Options for the native sysnet-linux integration. These options are read from System.Linux when System.Type is native or omitted on Linux.

KillswitchPath.description: Path used by the optional sysnet-linux killswitch client.

AppBypassMark.description: Firewall mark for daemon/app sockets that must bypass VPN routing. Default is 0xeb9f0001.

AppBypassMask.description: Mask used with AppBypassMark. Default matches all 32 mark bits.

UserMark.description: Firewall mark used for user-selected DefaultTun include/exclude routing. Default is 0x414c4d01.

UserMarkMask.description: Mask used with UserMark. Default matches all 32 mark bits.

KillswitchAllowExclude.description: Allow exclude rules to be represented in killswitch allow rules.

linuxFeatureConfig.description: Requested sysnet-linux feature set. Omit Features entirely to request sysnet-linux defaults; when this object is present, omitted booleans remain false.

linuxDNSConfig.description: Host DNS integration options passed to sysnet-linux.

Mode.description: DNS provider mode. Empty string auto-detects the host integration.

ResolvconfInterface.description: Provider-owned resolvconf record name. Empty uses sysnet-linux's default.

ResolvedInterfaceIndex.description: Interface index used by the systemd-resolved provider.

FallbackServers.description: Fallback DNS upstreams used when no original upstream resolver is available. Values may be IP addresses, which use port 53, or address:port values.

linuxPmarkConfig.description: Optional p-mark integration options passed to sysnet-linux. Callback fields are intentionally not configurable yet.

PinPath.description: bpffs directory used for p-mark and fwmark eBPF pins. Empty disables p-mark startup.

TombCollectionEvents.description: p-mark tombstone cleanup event interval. Zero uses p-mark defaults.

TombTTL.description: p-mark tombstone TTL as a Go time.Duration encoded in nanoseconds. Zero uses p-mark defaults.

Priority.description: Priority passed to sysnet-linux p-mark routing integration. Zero uses sysnet-linux defaults.

engineNodesConfig.description: Engine-owned main workspace configuration, keyed by pasta node name.

workspaceNodeConfig.description: A pasta workspace node record. Capitalized properties are workspace-owned. Properties that do not start with an uppercase ASCII letter are reserved for node implementation-owned state and are intentionally not documented here.

Class.description: Workspace-owned pasta node class name. Nodes without a string Class are ignored during restore.

Primary.description: Workspace-owned primary type override. Omitted when it equals the class default and has no retained HuJSON comment.

Pos.description: Workspace-owned opaque node position string used by the UI/workspace.

Links.description: Workspace-owned outgoing link specifications from this node's right ports to other nodes' left ports.

^[^A-Z].*$.description: Node implementation-owned state. Node classes may add, remove, or reinterpret these keys dynamically; by convention node-owned keys must not start with a capital ASCII letter.

nodeName.description: Pasta node name. Node names must be non-empty and cannot contain '[' or ']'.

className.description: Pasta class name, such as example.com/ClassName. The suffix starts with an uppercase ASCII letter.

typeName.description: Pasta type name, such as example.com/typeName, or the wildcard any/any. The suffix starts with a lowercase ASCII letter.

portName.description: Pasta port name. It must start and end with an ASCII alphanumeric character and may contain ASCII whitespace, space, '-', and '_' in between.

linkSpec.description: Outgoing link in pasta save format: '<right port> -> [<target node>] <left port>'. Target node names cannot contain '[' or ']'. Port names are restored only if valid for the target node class or placeholder.
